info.title: Mac Control HTTP API
info.description: Documentation revision reviewed 2026-11-02 against this repository. All current /api/ GET/POST operations; not a negotiated runtime API version. The separate openapi.json documents Notifier /v1/ routes. Native helper response shapes are intentionally extensible.

servers.description: Default origin; use an allowed LAN host and configured port as appropriate.

all_requests: source IP is private, loopback or link-local according to Python ipaddress
Host hostname is in the startup allowlist and port equals configured port; no userinfo
post: Origin must exactly equal http:// plus Host
application/json object with Content-Length from 1 through 4096 bytes

get.summary: Read optional Notifier copy activity through the local bridge
get.description: First integration use case. After authorization, pulls GET /v1/snapshot over fixed loopback with a server-held administrator bearer. 2-second timeout; 2 MiB cap; environment proxies disabled. Upstream/configuration failures caught by the bridge return HTTP 200 available=false. No ingestion, WebSocket or browser bearer auth. Local browser hides activity on fallback/request failure.

200.description: Successful request; inspect payload availability, capability and error fields.

401.description: Missing, expired or revoked session (loginRequired=true), or incorrect sign-in password.

get.summary: Read host battery and Tailscale status
get.description: Read-only local commands, two-second timeout each, shared ten-second demand-driven cache. Unavailable sensors return HTTP 200 with explicit unknown states; no peers, addresses or account data are returned.

200.description: Successful request; inspect payload availability, capability and error fields.

macControlSession.name: mac_control
macControlSession.description: HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/. Ordinary server expiry 24h with browser-session cookie; remembered expiry 30d and Max-Age=2592000. Fixed expiry; password change revokes all sessions.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Must exactly equal http:// plus the request Host (including configured port), even for a non-browser client or sign-in.

HardwareState.description: Extensible native/control-manager state. Unsupported numeric controls can be null; inspect capabilities and error.

ControlRequest.description: Value must be numeric; JSON booleans are rejected.

FanRequest.description: Target uses Celsius and needs helper v2+. Constant needs helper v3+, JSON integer RPMs (not float literals), one per detected fan in reported order, within firmware limits.

FanStatus.description: Helper-dependent fields; POST adds epoch time. Stats embeds status without adding time.

password.description: Only when mounted=true; at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes; no CR, LF or NUL. Never persisted as a mount preference.

items.description: Currently connected eligible USB target. Native helper fields include volume UUID id, name, model, size, connected, mounted, locked, state and volume metadata.
Sample: epoch time; nullable CPU/RAM/GPU percentages, memory, network bytes/s, temperatures in Celsius, fans and hardware-dependent metadata.

PowerSnapshot.description: Epoch timestamps in seconds; selected history is watts, today.history is cumulative Wh. Nulls preserve gaps. Daily totals reflect observed coverage; raw samples retained for 24 hours, daily totals for 90 days.

Connection.description: helperPath appears only for loopback clients; addresses is omitted.
